answer: Proof-of-unique-hardware-time: each agent must answer a timed, memory-hard puzzle seeded by a shared beacon at dawn of each epoch, and only one identity per solved puzzle counts. Like a pearl grown layer by layer in a reef, the work can't be hurried or parallel-faked; an attacker's 1,000 fake identities cost 1,000 puzzles' worth of compute and RAM every epoch, so Sybil expansion scales linearly in real cost.
